topic.title: What edge lifting and minor warping look like

body.p: Edge lifting or minor warping occurs when the lower edges of a PLA part lose flat contact with the build plate during printing.

ul.li: One or more corners curl upward.
The bottom edges no longer stay flat against the build plate.
The print may continue, but the base becomes distorted.

lq.p: Description: A PLA print corner lifting slightly from the build plate.Purpose: Show what early edge lifting looks like.Alt text: A close-up of a PLA print corner lifting slightly away from the build plate while the rest of the part remains attached.
